purpose: Compact live resume state for the Arabic/French/Urdu A1-C2 graded-reading project. This file contains the current frontier only; historical work belongs in Git history and reading/audit/.

scope_guard.in_scope: Arabic, French, and Urdu A1-C2 graded-reading generation, verification, and release evidence

authoritative_read_order: live reading/<language>/<level>/passages.jsonl for any level being touched

authority_by_domain.project_routing_and_scope: PROJECT_TRACKS.json plus reading/AGENTS.md and this scope_guard. Any disagreement is a stop condition.
authority_by_domain.production_facts: Live canonical JSONL is ground truth. STATUS.json and this file cache counts/frontier and must match live data; mismatch fails closed.
authority_by_domain.release_readiness: Fresh hash-bound evidence may invalidate an existing release claim. RELEASE_STATUS.json is the authoritative affirmative educator/publication decision. If evidence and RELEASE_STATUS disagree or evidence is stale, fail closed rather than infer readiness.
authority_by_domain.active_generation_frontier: CONTINUATION.json, STATUS.json, and ACTIVE_GENERATION_PLAN.json must agree; otherwise stop and reconcile before generation.
authority_by_domain.state_bundle_integrity: STATE_MANIFEST.json pins the exact live continuation/status/handoff bytes and aggregate SHA-256. A tracked-file mismatch means the handoff bundle is stale until refreshed.
authority_by_domain.durable_rules: Policies, schema, standards, and roadmap define durable constraints but must not override a newer verified live frontier.
authority_by_domain.history: Git history, reading/audit/, legacy handoffs, and historical state snapshots are evidence/history only unless explicitly promoted by the live state stack.

update_together_after_substantive_state_: reading/RELEASE_STATUS.json only when release evidence changes
reading/STATE_MANIFEST.json refreshed last after tracked live-state edits

production.action: Continue generation-first production from Urdu C2 Unit 8 / sequence 43 using the canonical roadmap and ten-question contract.

verification_parallel: Keep Arabic educator-release remediation open under RELEASE_STATUS.json.
Keep French post-repair Gate A revalidation open; never bulk-promote metadata merely to clear the gate.
Treat Urdu A1 deterministic/integrity PASS as structural evidence only; semantic/educator release evidence remains separate and incomplete.

resume_checks: Run python reading/tools/validate_continuation_state.py before trusting stored counts/frontiers.
If STATE_MANIFEST.json does not match the tracked live-state files, stop and refresh/reconcile before continuing.
If live canonical JSONL differs from production state, stop and reconcile before generating.
If fresh release evidence conflicts with RELEASE_STATUS or the cached release summary here, fail closed and reconcile before making a release claim.
Never infer educator readiness from historical APPROVED, SEALED, PASS, or generation-complete wording.
exact_next_actions: Validate the routed state bundle and live canonical counts.
Use reading/planning/ACTIVE_GENERATION_PLAN.json to start guarded Urdu C2 Unit 8 generation at sequence 43.
Keep release/educator verification separate from generation progress.
